name: StarMade
description: This container will download and install a StarMade Dedicated Server. It will also install a basic server.cfg at the first startup. UPDATE: The container will check on every restart if there is a newer version of StarMade available.

ports.name: TCP - Game Port
ports.description: TCP - Game Port (If you need another port delete this entry and create a new Port with the corresponding port numbers).

variables.name: Extra Game Parameters
variables.description: Enter your extra startup parameters otherwise leave blank!

variables.name: XMS Size
variables.description: Enter your XMS size in MB (XMS=The initial and minimum heap size. It is recommended to set the minimum heap size equivalent to the maximum heap size in order to minimize the garbage collection.)

variables.name: XMX Size
variables.description: Enter your XMX size in MB (XMX=The maximum heap size. The performance will decrease if the max heap value is set lower than the amount of live data. It will force frequent garbage collections in order to free up space.)

variables.name: Runtime Name
variables.description: Enter your extracted Runtime folder name. Don't change unless you are knowing what you are doing!

variables.name: Starter Parameters
variables.description: Only change if you know what you are doing!

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: Only change if you know what you are doing!
